reference: PLAN: First, find information about the Lex Antonia law and its impact. Next, identify the Roman general associated with the revival of the dictatorship and the nullification of the dictatorial laws.

descendants_plus.hop_2:
The Lex Antonia was a law established in ancient Rome in April 44 BC. It was proposed by Mark Antony and passed by the Roman Senate, following the assassination of Julius Caesar. It formally abolished the Dictatorship.

FINDING: Lex Antonia
